Ripgrep searches files quickly. Back to the [[index|harbour index]].

## Usage

Run `rg tide` to find every mention of a tide. The first link in this note goes to [[guides/tides]].

## Long lines

A long unbroken token to check overflow at phone width: `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.
